tools.name: about_humanmcp
tools.description: Self-description of this humanMCP server. Deterministic, no bootstrap required — call this first to decide whether the rest of the API is relevant.

tools.name: ask_human
tools.description: Submit an async question to kapoost. Returns an ID. Rate-limited 5/hr/IP. Poll fetch_answer later — kapoost answers on his own schedule (minutes, hours, or days).

tools.name: bootstrap_session
tools.description: Validate the Polish poetry session code, then emit the full team briefing (guardian + style + personas + skills + persist block). Rate-limited 5/min/IP.

tools.name: delete_skill
tools.description: Delete a skill by slug. Owner-only: requires Authorization: Bearer <token>.

tools.name: fetch_answer
tools.description: Poll for an answer to an ask_human question. Marks the question as fetched the first time an answer is returned. Rate-limited 30/hr/IP.

tools.name: fetch_narada_result
tools.description: Poll a narada job by ID. Statuses: pending, running, done, failed. When done, returns all persona voices.

tools.name: get_author_profile
tools.description: Author identity, bio, and a browsing cheatsheet. Records a profile-view event.

tools.name: get_certificate
tools.description: Return a formatted copyright/authenticity certificate for a piece.

tools.name: get_persona
tools.description: Return one persona's full prompt by slug. Session-gated except for Hodor (guardian rules must always apply). Pass session_token if your client cannot set an Authorization header.

tools.name: get_persona_journal
tools.description: Read a persona's raw reflection journal. Owner-only — the journal is a private feedback loop, not for external callers.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Return one skill's full body by slug. Session-gated except for -public suffixed skills (guardian bypass). Pass session_token if your client cannot set an Authorization header.

tools.name: leave_comment
tools.description: Attach a short comment (≤280 chars) to a piece kapoost has published. Truncated silently past the limit.

tools.name: leave_message
tools.description: Send kapoost a longer message. context REQUIRED (why you're writing / which piece / which task). contact optional — without it no reply is possible.

tools.name: list_blobs
tools.description: List typed data artifacts (images, contact, vectors, documents, datasets, capsules). Filter by blob_type. Readable-column reflects caller_kind + caller_id vs audience.

tools.name: list_collection
tools.description: List works kapoost owns but did NOT create. Public items always; members-only surface only after session activation.

tools.name: list_content
tools.description: List published pieces (slug, title, type, access, tags). Optional type/tag filters.

tools.name: list_personas
tools.description: List every persona (slug, title, role). Full prompts unlock after bootstrap_session.

tools.name: list_provenance
tools.description: List provenance items (chain of custody, certificates, invoices) for an artwork slug. Tries piece then collection.

tools.name: list_skill_groups
tools.description: Index of every skill tag in use, with slugs per group. Public — no bootstrap required.

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: List skills (slug, category, title, tags). Optional category / tag filters.

tools.name: load_skill_group
tools.description: Bulk-fetch every skill tagged with the given group name. Respects the bootstrap gate per-skill: -public suffix bypasses, everything else needs session.

tools.name: mysloodsiewnia_get
tools.description: Fetch one document from kapoost's vault by slug. Requires Authorization: Bearer <edit token or friend token>. Friend tokens: vault-side filter enforces scope + access:private invisibility — an out-of-scope or private slug returns not_found. Vault offline ⇒ {status:offline}.

tools.name: mysloodsiewnia_list
tools.description: Enumerate vault documents without FTS — for browsing by type or paginating. Requires Authorization: Bearer <edit token or friend token>. Friend tokens see only their scoped doc_types; access:private is invisible. Args: {doc_type?: string filter (note/pdf/literatura/calendar_event/...), limit?: int 1

tools.name: mysloodsiewnia_search
tools.description: Full-text search (BM25 over SQLite FTS5) on kapoost's local vault corpus. Requires Authorization: Bearer <edit token or friend token>. Friend tokens see only their scoped doc_types; access:private is invisible. Returns {status, results:[{source, type, body, doc_slug, title, page, citation}], summary

tools.name: mysloodsiewnia_status
tools.description: Read-only liveness probe on kapoost's local vault (mysłoodsiewnia). Returns {status: online|degraded|offline, last_seen, commit_sha, personas_updated_at, skills_updated_at}. Offline is a stable state — retry later, don't escalate. Requires Authorization: Bearer <edit token or friend token>.

tools.name: mysloodsiewnia_write
tools.description: Ingest a new document into kapoost's vault (wave 2). OWNER-ONLY — friend tokens receive {status:write_denied,reason:owner_only}. Args: {doc_type (required), title (required), body (required, ≤100 KiB), source_path?, meta?}. Requires Authorization: Bearer <owner token>. On Unauthorized: obtain the to

tools.name: prepare_narada
tools.description: Offline narada: returns the panel plus each persona's ready-to-run SYSTEM/USER prompts so YOU run them as your own subagents, instead of the server generating voices. No LLM cost, no rate limit, nothing recorded — no narada ID and no journal feedback. Prefer this over run_narada when your subagents

tools.name: read_blob
tools.description: Read one blob by slug. Returns text or base64-encoded data. Access-gated by audience unless blob is public.

tools.name: read_collection_item
tools.description: Full record for one collection item + dossier count. Access-gated: private is never visible, members needs session.

tools.name: read_content
tools.description: Read a public piece by slug. Locked pieces return a hint pointing at request_access.

tools.name: read_provenance
tools.description: Return one provenance item with resolvable file URLs. slug + id required.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: List memories saved under the given code, optionally substring-filtered by query. Session-gated for symmetry with remember.

tools.name: record_persona_reflection
tools.description: Ask a persona to write a lesson-for-self after a rolled-back narada recommendation. Appends to the persona's journal via Sonnet/Haiku. Owner-only.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Persist a note under the given session code. Session-gated — bootstrap_session first. Callers sharing the code share the memory.

tools.name: request_access
tools.description: Get the gate details for a locked piece: challenge question, manual-review flow, time-lock countdown, payment terms, or trade rules.

tools.name: request_license
tools.description: Declare intended use of a piece, get licensing terms + audit-log entry. caller_id is REQUIRED (whitespace-only rejected — storyboard-pinned).

tools.name: run_narada
tools.description: Create an async narada job: server routes context to 3-5 personas via keyword manifest, then generates each voice via Sonnet 4.6 (Haiku 4.5 for journal recaps). Returns job ID for polling. Pass `personas` to pick the voices yourself and skip the router entirely — the router matches keywords only and

tools.name: submit_answer
tools.description: Submit an answer to a challenge-gated piece. Correct answer unlocks and returns the full body.

tools.name: suggest_skills
tools.description: Deterministic manifest→tag mapping. Given files + languages + git_origin, returns up to 8 skill slugs and up to 5 personas, each with the reason it fired. No LLM classification.

tools.name: synthesise_persona_patterns
tools.description: Force-run Sonnet synthesis over a persona's raw journal, replacing the previous pattern set. Owner-only — paid + writes internal state.

tools.name: upsert_skill
tools.description: Create or replace a skill by slug. Owner-only: requires Authorization: Bearer <token>. Writes JSON to content/skills/<slug>.json.

tools.name: verify_content
tools.description: Verify a piece's Ed25519 signature against the server's owner public key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_provenance, request_access · Private data: delete_skill, get_author_profile, get_persona_journal, leave_message, list_blobs, mysloodsiewnia_get, mysloodsiewnia_list, mysloodsiewnia_search, mysloodsiewnia_status, mysloodsiewnia_write, prepare_narada, read_collection_item, read_provenance, record_persona_reflection, suggest_skills, upsert_skill · Public sink: ask_human, leave_message, remember, submit_answer · Destructive: delete_skill, mysloodsiewnia_write, prepare_narada, run_narada, synthesise_persona_patterns.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_provenance, request_access · Private data: delete_skill, get_author_profile, get_persona_journal, leave_message, list_blobs, mysloodsiewnia_get, mysloodsiewnia_list, mysloodsiewnia_search, mysloodsiewnia_status, mysloodsiewnia_write, prepare_narada, read_collection_item, read_provenance, record_persona_reflection, suggest_skills, upsert_skill · Public sink: ask_human, leave_message, remember, submit_answer · Destructive: delete_skill, mysloodsiewnia_write, prepare_narada, run_narada, synthesise_persona_patterns

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
